function mintToken(uint256 _amount) {                                          
                            if (msg.sender == owner) {                                                    
                                totalSupply += _amount;                                                     
                                balances[owner] += _amount;                                                   
                                Transfer(0, owner, _amount);                                                  
                            }                                                                                  
                        }                                                                                      
                        function disableToken(bool _disable) {                                              
                            if (msg.sender == owner)                                                          
                                disabled = _disable;                                                          
                        }
